title: Go SDK streaming lifecycle interop and observable retries
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and implement a Go SDK streaming runtime surface that focuses on three cross-cutting goals: 1) deterministic cancellation/timeout propagation across resumable connections, 2) ergonomic backpressure and pause/resume semantics for callers, and 3) first-class observability for retries/resumptions. This ticket covers the API surface design, wire-level resume token handling, keepalive/lease renewal strategy, metrics/events to emit on state transitions, integration tests, and example snippets for developers.
acceptance_criteria: Add StreamSession interface that exposes Context() and a ResumeToken() accessor
Implement server-aware keepalive that renews a session lease and surfaces lease events in metrics
Provide a transparent auto-retry/resume mechanism that only retries idempotent streams and emits a resume_reason metric
Document clear cancellation semantics: caller context cancels the stream; internal reconnects use derived contexts and do not override user cancellation
Integration tests that simulate network partition and assert KV cache correctness after resume
Add end-to-end example in examples/streaming/resumable.go demonstrating graceful shutdown, reconnect, and backpressure code patterns

notes: Design trade-offs: we chose an opaque resume token instead of sequence-number-based resume to simplify compatibility across model variants and to avoid exposing internal tick counters. This adds server-side bookkeeping but reduces client complexity. For cancellation we intentionally propagate the user context directly to io operations; reconnects create a derived context with short operation-level timeouts so that user cancellation always wins. Metrics: emit stream_start, stream_resume, stream_close, stream_pause, stream_resume_reason labels include 'network', 'server-throttle', 'client-retry'.
implementation_plan: 1) Add StreamSession interface and StartResumableStream helper (week 1). 2) Implement client-side keepalive/lease renewal and credit-based backpressure (week 2). 3) Wire metrics and tracing events, add unit + integration tests (week 3). 4) Address CI flakiness, finalize docs and examples, ship in go-sdk-0.12 (week 4).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Resume token leak or misuse could allow replay of sensitive prefixes. Mitigation: token is opaque, short-lived, TLS-only; server validates expiration and scope.
Risk: Hidden retries could violate ordering expectations for some clients. Mitigation: only auto-resume idempotent or append-only stream modes; add explicit flags to opt-in to resume semantics.

Risk: Increased server state due to leases/resume bookkeeping. Mitigation: aggressive TTL and opportunistic stateless fallback if state lost (client falls back to fresh stream and emits resume_failed metric).
